name: Windblown Wisp, Greater
body:
Windblown Wisp, Greater

School transmutation [air, curse]; Level adept 3, druid 3, hunter 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, M (a dandelion seed)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as windblown wisp, except that the creature is treated as being two size categories smaller.
